name: Ghost Combat
description: Legit-looking combat helpers: bow, pearl and rod use on the silent rotation, trapping an enemy or yourself with blocks.

addons.SelfBlockIn: Surrounds your own feet with blocks while you stand still, so enemies cannot reach you from the sides.
addons.AutoTrap: Surrounds the nearest enemy with blocks: four around their feet and four around their head.
addons.AutoBow: Draws a bow at the nearest enemy and releases once fully charged, only when the real ray hits them.
addons.AutoPearl: Throws an ender pearl at an enemy at a distance, aimed at their feet. The arc is not modelled.
addons.AutoRod: Casts a fishing rod at a nearby enemy and reels in on a bite.
addons.BowAimbot: Turns your camera onto the nearest enemy while a bow is drawn, leading the shot (camera aim, not silent).
